Black Friday is the one week a year when building a proper movie setup doesn’t cost a fortune. It’s the best time of year to upgrade both your gear and your collection. Whether that means improving your own living room home theater setup or shopping for the cinephile who already owns physical copies of everything, these are the deals worth your money, from 50%-off Criterion 4Ks to an LG OLED at nearly half price.

As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases. Prices come from Amazon and are accurate as of the time shown on each card, but they change often, especially around Black Friday.

FAQ

When is Black Friday 2026?

Black Friday 2026 is Friday, November 27, the day after Thanksgiving (Thursday, November 26). Cyber Monday follows on November 30. Many retailers start Black Friday deals the week before.

What is a good gift for a movie lover?

A 4K or Criterion edition of a favorite film, a soundbar or streaming box that upgrades movie night, or a great film book like Hitchcock/Truffaut. For under $25, popcorn seasoning, a theater gift card, or a scratch-off movie poster are easy wins.

Are 4K Blu-rays worth it in the streaming era?

Yes, if picture and sound quality matter to you. 4K discs offer higher bitrates than streaming, so detail and audio hold up better on big screens, and you own the movie even after it leaves a streaming service.

When does Criterion go on sale?

Criterion titles are often discounted around Black Friday, and Barnes & Noble has traditionally run a 50%-off Criterion sale in November. Check retailer listings for the exact dates.
